title: Vibrant Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A sweet and snappy Malaysian dish featuring chicken marinated in a mixture of spices and sauces, then grilled to perfection, served with a side of smoke-hot Chinese sesame sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the chicken breast skewers to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the Chinese sesame sauce by whisking all the ingredients together in a bowl.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush with the Chinese sesame sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds and paprika.
Serve the satay hot with additional Chinese sesame sauce for dipping.
Garnish with sliced onions, cucumbers, and carrots, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
